note: The monthly count of new repositories created in the organisation. Zero-creation months are shown as 0 so the full timeline is visible.
methodology: Fetch every repository in the organisation via the GitHub GraphQL API.
Extract each repository's createdAt timestamp and bucket it by calendar month.
Count repos created per month; months with zero creations are filled in so the timeline is continuous.
The peak month and the latest month are annotated on the chart.
population: Repositories currently in the organisation, by the month GitHub records them as created. Deleted or transferred-out repositories are not counted.
